Posted January 22, 2001

The new BC Marijuana Party ran a full page ad in the mass circulation Vancouver Province on Sunday. The Province has the largest circulation in BC.

The ad cost Marc Emery around C$7,000.

The party platform goes beyond just marijuana legalization, but this is necessary to broaden its base.

Text of ad --

Sunday January 21, 2001
THE VANCOUVER PROVINCE
FULL PAGE AD

Announcing the Marijuana Party of British Columbia

The Marijuana Party of British Columbia advocates a platform of Choices, Options and Tolerance. We believe that people should be free to make decisions about their own bodies and how they wish to live their lives, without undue intrusion by the government or police.

As members of an oppressed and outlawed culture, many of us have experienced first-hand the indignity of police harassment, arrest and government persecution because of our personal beliefs and lifestyle choices.

We want to reverse the trend towards more government control over our daily lives, and stop the political weakness which prevents new thinking and innovative solutions to the problems which currently face us.

Our policies are aimed at maximizing the ability of all British Columbians to control their own destiny, and limiting the ability of the government and police to interfere with our peaceful, personal activities and beliefs.

BC Marijuana Party platform

CHOICES, OPTIONS, TOLERANCE

* The removal of provincial funding for marijuana prohibition enforcement.

* A viable ballot initiative system to allow for direct public democracy.

* A school " voucher " system to allow all parents more choices in education.

* A rational drug policy that includes decriminalization, harm reduction and prescription of heroin and cocaine.

* An end to street prostitution by legalizing licensed brothels.

* Strong opposition to US military presence and nuclear weapons in British Columbia.

* Offering " restorative justice " as an option for victims of crime.

* Provincial refusal to prosecute charges for non-registration of firearms.

* Acknowledgment of First Nations right to self-determination and self-sufficiency.

* No new taxes.

We want your help! We are seeking additional candidates, volunteers, and financial contributions. We intend on fielding candidates in all 79 electoral districts.

BC Marijuana Party
(604) 684-7076
